exchanges.response_text:
[[columns]]
name = "order_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Primary key for orders."

[[columns]]
name = "customer_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Foreign key referencing the customers table."

[[columns]]
name = "amount"
type = "Float64"
nullable = false
description = "Order amount."

[[columns]]
name = "status"
type = "String"
nullable = false
description = "Current status of the order."

[[columns]]
name = "coupon"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Optional coupon code applied to the order."

[rules]
required = ["order_id", "customer_id"]
protected = ["order_id", "customer_id"]
